notes.title: New UPDATE FIX BUGS , DELETES YOUR SAVE FILES
notes.content:
Hello Folks , 

I just released a new update and sadly this will delete your savegames files since the updated changes a few things :  


This should fix the GAME CRASH and uses less Ram now you should easily play in full screen without crashes :)
There are less checkpoints now  
There'll be a save game folder now on your steam game directory this way the next update will not delete your savegames files
[spoiler]Fix the old mine boxes bugs[/spoiler]
Fix sound Fx effects
New sounds are going to make your experience better 
A thumb was added to the soundtrack dlc



After testing new bugs came out but now they're fixed :) ! Thank you all who helped me reporting 'em

Let me know guys id there's still persistence of any bug
Endrit :)
